messages:
Jordan Lee: Opening a 60m change window to apply TF changes for iam mapping + subnet route updates tied to the 2026-03 release. Need to pin module refs, provider, and a clear rollback ladder.

Priya Nair: Please paste the exact pins so I can include them in release notes. Also add the contact for rollback.

Jordan Lee: Pinned module + tfvars below:
```
module "iam_mapping" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-infra/modules.git//iam/mapping?ref=chore/pin-2026-03-17-1b2c3d"
}

// terraform.tfvars.json
{
  "shared_subnet_ids": ["subnet-0a1b2c3d", "subnet-4e5f6a7b"],
  "mapping_role_arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-iam-map"
}
```

Jordan Lee: Provider pin suggested: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 5.2" } }`

Deploybot: Preflight: terraform plan will run in 3m. If plan changes >0 shared subnet routes or deletes, the run will pause and notify.

Kenji Tanaka: For safety, let's do staggered apply per subnet group. I'll take the first group and monitor route propagation.

Priya Nair: I'll draft the rollback ladder:
1) Stop subsequent AZ/subnet applies.
2) Revert the module ref to `release/2026-03-10-stable` and apply with `terraform apply -var-file=revert.tfvars.json`.
3) If traffic still impacted, failover traffic to backup TGW and escalate to SRE.

Jordan Lee: Adding smoke tests: curl payment health endpoints, verify internal traceroute to payment service, and check route tables for expected entries. Priya add these commands to release notes.

ops-bot: @channel Reminder: create release tracker entry and attach plan output and run ids.

Deploybot: Preflight result: plan OK (no deletions on shared subnets). Canary apply queued job=jt-9990 in 5m.

Kenji Tanaka: Starting canary for subnet-group-1 (job=jt-9990). Posting plan and will stream logs.

(6m later)
Kenji Tanaka: Canary apply completed for group-1. smoke tests pass. No route flaps detected. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/jt-9990

Jordan Lee: Good. Scheduling remainder in staggered 10m increments. Locking tfvars and tagging infra commit to chore/pin-2026-03-17-1b2c3d.

ops-bot: Prod apply queued (job=jt-9991), owner=Kenji Tanaka, eta=12m. Automated rollback watch ON.

Priya Nair: I'll be watching for HTTP 502/504 spikes and route change alerts. If >1% error spike or route-flap >2 in 5m, trigger rollback.

Kenji Tanaka: Starting prod apply (jt-9991). Streaming logs to thread.

(8m later)
Deploybot: Prod apply finished: success. run_id=jt-9991. No destructive changes.

Priya Nair: Updated release notes with module commit, provider pin, run ids, and rollback commands. QA to sign off before announce. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Lee: Thanks all. Closing change window in 30m and marking infra commit pinned to chore/pin-2026-03-17-1b2c3d. :lock:

Kenji Tanaka: All good from my side. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: add run_id=jt-9991 to release tracker and notify #release-announce after QA signoff.
